Name: Cat paw relationship indicators
Author: Angel1na
Description:
You can choose CP Mod or xnb Mod to download.

[b]How to install it?[/b]

[b]For CP version:[/b]
1. install the last version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Download the CP file and unpack it.
3. Drop it into Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\
4. Run the game with SMAPI.﻿

[b]For xnb version:[/b]
1. Download this file.
2. Place it into Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites and replace the vanilla file.

[b]If you choose xnb version, make sure you back-up the old file in order to uninstall it easier.

[/b]——————————————————————————————————————————

你可以选择下载CP格式或xnb格式的Mod。

[b]如何安装？[/b]

[b]CP格式：[/b]
1. 下载并安装最新版本的 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ 和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. 下载并解压CP格式的文件。
3. 将文件夹放在路径 Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\ 中。
4. 用SMAPI 启动游戏。

[b]xnb格式：[/b]
1. 下载这个文件。
2. 将文件放在路径 Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites 中，并替换原有文件。

[b]如果你选择下载xnb格式，建议提前备份游戏原文件以便卸载。


[/b]Enjoy it ！！！
